description: Where a deployer writes a vault-native secret.

cliCommand.description: Command that writes the value, with `<VALUE>` in place of the secret.

consoleUrl.description: Cloud console page where the secret is created, when the store has one.

deleteCommand.description:
Command that deletes the secret. Deleting a deployment keeps the
secrets the deployer wrote, since Alien never owned their values.

name.description: Full name of the secret in that store.

vaultName.description:
The Azure Key Vault that holds the secret. Other stores resolve `name`
in the stack's own account or project.
